title: Radhanagar Beach - Asia's Award-Winning Tropical Paradise in Andaman
content:
Radhanagar Beach, Andaman: Explore India's Tropical Paradise

Imagine walking across soft white sand, watching turquoise waves roll gently towards the shore, and witnessing a spectacular sunset over the Bay of Bengal. This is the magic of Radhanagar Beach, one of the most beautiful coastal destinations in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

Located on Swaraj Dweep, formerly known as Havelock Island, Radhanagar Beach is famous for its pristine shoreline, lush tropical forests, and breathtaking ocean views. Whether you are planning a romantic honeymoon, a family holiday, or a peaceful escape from city life, this beach offers a memorable tropical experience.

Where Is Radhanagar Beach Located?

Radhanagar Beach, also known as Beach No. 7, is located on the western coast of Swaraj Dweep in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, India.

The beach is accessible from the island's main jetty by road. Visitors can hire a taxi, rent a scooter where permitted, or arrange local transport to reach this scenic destination.

Its combination of white sand, blue waters, and green surroundings makes it one of the most photographed beaches in the Andaman Islands.

Why Is Radhanagar Beach Famous?

Radhanagar Beach gained international recognition when Time magazine named it among Asia's best beaches in 2004. Its natural beauty continues to attract travellers from India and around the world.

Here are some reasons why it deserves a place on your travel bucket list:

  • White sandy shoreline: Enjoy relaxing walks along the beautiful coast.

  • Turquoise waters: Admire the changing shades of blue across the sea.

  • Beautiful sunsets: Watch the sky transform into warm shades of orange, pink, and purple.

  • Tropical greenery: Explore the natural landscape surrounding the beach.

  • Peaceful atmosphere: Take a break from busy city life and enjoy the sound of the waves.

  • Photography opportunities: Capture scenic landscapes and memorable holiday moments.

Top Things to Do at Radhanagar Beach

1. Watch a Spectacular Sunset

Sunset is one of the biggest highlights of Radhanagar Beach. As the sun approaches the horizon, the changing colours of the sky create a beautiful backdrop for the coastline.

Arrive early, find a comfortable spot, and enjoy the scenery without rushing. Remember to check the local sunset time and beach access hours.

2. Take a Relaxing Beach Walk

The soft sandy shoreline is ideal for leisurely walks. Feel the sea breeze, admire the tropical surroundings, and enjoy the peaceful rhythm of the waves.

Early mornings and late afternoons can be particularly pleasant for exploring the beach.

3. Enjoy Swimming When Conditions Are Safe

Swimming may be permitted in designated areas when sea conditions allow. However, currents, tides, and weather can change, so always follow lifeguard instructions and local safety notices.

Avoid entering the water during rough conditions or outside designated swimming zones.

4. Capture Beautiful Coastal Photographs

Radhanagar Beach is a wonderful destination for photography enthusiasts. You can photograph the sweeping shoreline, turquoise sea, tropical vegetation, and dramatic sunset colours.

For the best results, use the softer light of early morning or late afternoon and respect other visitors' privacy.

5. Relax Amid Nature

Sometimes, the best travel experience is simply slowing down. Spend time enjoying the natural surroundings, listening to the waves, and appreciating the beauty of the Andaman coastline.

Remember to take all your waste with you and avoid disturbing wildlife or coastal vegetation.

Best Time to Visit Radhanagar Beach

The most popular period for visiting Radhanagar Beach is generally October to May, when conditions are often more suitable for beach holidays and outdoor sightseeing.

  • October to February: Pleasant conditions for sightseeing, coastal walks, and photography, although weather can vary.

  • March to May: Often warmer, making it attractive for beach relaxation and swimming when conditions are safe.

  • June to September: The monsoon season can bring heavy rainfall and rough seas, potentially affecting ferry services and water activities.

Always check the latest weather forecast, ferry schedules, and local beach advisories before travelling.

How to Reach Radhanagar Beach

By Air

Fly to Veer Savarkar International Airport in Sri Vijaya Puram, formerly Port Blair, the main air gateway to the Andaman Islands.

By Ferry

From Sri Vijaya Puram, take an available government or private ferry to Swaraj Dweep. Journey times vary by service, weather, and sea conditions, so confirm the schedule in advance.

By Road

After arriving at Swaraj Dweep's jetty, continue by taxi or other available local transport. Radhanagar Beach is approximately 10–12 kilometres from the jetty, depending on the route.

Nearby Places to Explore

Make your Andaman holiday more memorable by visiting other attractions around Swaraj Dweep.

  • Elephant Beach: Known for water activities and marine experiences when conditions permit.

  • Kalapathar Beach: A scenic coastal spot popular for its distinctive rocks and peaceful surroundings.

  • Vijaynagar Beach: A relaxing place to enjoy the island's coastal scenery.

  • Swaraj Dweep Jetty: The main arrival point for visitors travelling to the island.

Plan your route and transport in advance so you can explore comfortably without rushing.

Essential Travel Tips for Radhanagar Beach

Before visiting, keep these practical tips in mind:

  • Carry sunscreen, sunglasses, and a reusable water bottle.

  • Wear comfortable footwear for walking on sand.

  • Check beach opening hours and local restrictions.

  • Swim only where permitted and when conditions are safe.

  • Carry some cash for small local purchases.

  • Keep the beach clean and avoid single-use plastic where possible.

  • Allow enough time to return to your accommodation before local transport becomes limited.

Conclusion: Make Radhanagar Beach Your Next Island Escape

Radhanagar Beach is more than a beautiful stretch of coastline. It is a place where natural beauty, peaceful surroundings, and unforgettable sunsets come together to create a memorable holiday experience.

From relaxing beach walks to scenic photography and exploring the neighbouring beaches of Swaraj Dweep, there are plenty of ways to enjoy this tropical destination.

If you are planning an Andaman holiday, add Radhanagar Beach to your itinerary and discover why it remains one of India's most celebrated beach destinations.
excerpt: Radhanagar Beach is one of the most beautiful beaches in Asia, famous for its soft white sand, crystal-clear waters, and spectacular sunsets. Located on Havelock Island (Swaraj Dweep), it offers the perfect setting for swimming, photography, beach walks, and relaxation. Its untouched natural beauty makes it a must-visit destination in the Andaman Islands.
